title: Level A – Cleanest (Gold Standard)
whatItMeans: Use released APIs only (public CDS views, OData V4, RAP, BTP services). Do not read SAP internal tables directly. SAP officially supports these interfaces.
beginnerAnalogy: You use Microsoft Excel's built-in functions to create charts. You never open C:\Windows\System32\ to access system files.
description: SAP BTP (Analytics Cloud, CAP apps)
technology: Fiori Elements (List Report, Analytical List Page)
upgradeComplexity: Purchase Order Items Report - Built as a Fiori Elements List Report using released CDS view I_PurchaseOrderItem exposed as OData.
column16: No risk of breaking when SAP updates standard code

title: Level B – Classic but Acceptable
whatItMeans: Use classic APIs like BAPIs, RFCs, or function modules. Still no direct table reads, but uses older (stable) interfaces.
beginnerAnalogy: You use older COM add-ins or macros that still work but aren't recommended for new projects.
description: PO Details Report (ALV) - Fetches data via BAPI_PO_GETDETAIL and displays in ALV grid.
cloudReadiness: Plan to migrate to Level A eventually
column16: acceptable when Level A artifacts are unavailable

title: Level C – Risky Legacy

technicalRisk: common in legacy systems but upgrade risk is high
